column3: This is BlockID Business Passport: know the business you invest in. A live, checked view of the business you own, with dividends paid to your wallet.
Today, investors lose sight of a business once they invest. The numbers are hard to trust, ownership sits in spreadsheets, and dividends are slow, or never come.

The need is large. Alternative assets are heading to thirty-two trillion dollars by 2030, and venture investors put in four hundred and twenty-five billion last year. Yet in 2024, private equity paid back just eleven percent of its value, a ten-year low.
Here is the live app, on testnet. No sign-up: a demo investor sees each holding at the latest approved price, and the dividends already paid.
Each holding shows your stake, a price that moves only after approval, and shared updates.
To check a business, paste its website. AI agents read it, find competitors and analyse the market. They hold no keys. They only propose.
You get a grade, a score and a value range, and every figure links to its source.
A person approves every step, signed by an admin wallet. Only then does the issuer act.
The share register lives on BlockID chain, mirrored to Ethereum and HashKey Chain.
Businesses open offerings with the dilution shown first, and dividends reach every wallet with no gas.
Don't trust us. Your browser checks the report against three blockchains. Change one number, and it turns red.

What does each side get? Investors get a checked value, the same update at the same time, proof of ownership, and dividends on time. In return, the business keeps a live share register, as Australian and Vietnamese law already require, reports on schedule, and has a person approve every new share and dividend.

This also prepares for tokenised assets. On-chain real-world assets grew from about seven to thirty-nine billion dollars in nineteen months, and Citi expects five and a half trillion by 2030. New rules demand proper custody. In BlockID, keys sit only in an isolated issuer, every holder is verified, and a licensed custodian can plug in.
On HashKey Chain, AgentProvenance records which agent proposed, and which person approved.
BlockID HR checks the founding team: each requirement against public sources and the CV.
Today the full flow runs on testnet: fourteen sample listings, forty-two token contracts on three chains, every report verified, and over five hundred tests. No real users yet.
Next: pilot businesses in Australia and Vietnam, investor communities, and licensed custody partners. Agents propose. Humans approve. Chains prove. Try it at eth dot blockid dot au.
